The page text is the textContent of the body; as the raise of the bar of О19, also document.title and the attributes aria-label, title, alt and placeholder of every element. (2) Issue I1, the requests of B's page: every request of the page from the open of B's address to B's result goes under B's address /t/<B>/ or to a shared path that the test names with its reason (measure the paths first; the favicon line of the kit may be one); assert that, and that nothing goes under /t/<A>/.

result.summary: Re-run 2 of step 05g (WF-02, step 5b, an edit of an already checked file by decisions/0109 О19), F6, I1, I4 of step 05f. The file at my start was the unchecked edit of the first launch (sha256 ffff3a819bd2b510, equal to the task); I checked it point by point with my own measurement on the correct server (real Chrome, both pairs, my own script that shares no code with the spec) and my own mutants on copies, kept what holds and fixed what did not. KEPT (first launch, verified): the reads of B's page on the card, on each question screen of B's pass (when it is shown and again after its answer) and on the result screen (before and after its answer is read); the rule of О17 as corrected applied to the page with the measured exception pinned; the request check of B's page with the one named shared path /assets/<name> and the control that every record has its answer (a dedicated or shared worker shows as its script with no answer); the key checks (no key of B's three answers holds a text or a solution name of A, no exception; every key of B's two answers is a key of B's file or one of 13 named fields, the error answer held to its own 3 fields); the I4 comment. FIXED by me, because 7 own mutants survived the start file: (1) an exception word of A («человек») was compared with whole texts only, so the same word placed inside another text or an attribute of B's team screen passed (A2d, A2f): every text node, the title, the address and every attribute that holds it must now be one of B's file texts shown on that screen, and the pin is the measured holder read from the page («человек» in «Есть отдельный человек»); (2) only 4 attributes were read, so A's name in aria-valuetext of the progress bar or in aria-description passed (A15, A16): every attribute is read; (3) the address of the page was not read (A19): it is read, decoded; (4) a service worker of B's page asked A's questionnaire outside the page records (A14; a probe copy with a request log showed the server got GET /t/uchet-pro/api/questionnaire after B's open): the test asserts the origin has no service worker registration; (5) a shared path could bring A's data (A18: /assets/peek.js served A's questionnaire): what B's page got under its page address and the shared paths must hold no text or solution name of A. Measured on the correct server: on B's screens only «человек» inside B's own option on the team screen of svet-marketing (no fixed text of the page holds a text of A; title, every attribute and the address hold none); B's page asks its page, 12 files under /assets/, its questionnaire and its result (no /favicon.ico, which comes once with A's first load; no service worker); the keys outside B's file are exactly the 13 fields the gate measured (leads only in pair 1, stock's file has that key) and error, message, question for the error answer; no key holds a text of A. issues.text: Survivors by the rule of no wait by time (for ORCH; not fixable inside the rules of this step). A text of A that the page adds later than the test reads the screen is not seen: own probes T1 (A's name on B's card 300 ms after it appears), T2 (on B's result screen 300 ms after it appears), T3 (on each question screen 300 ms after it appears) stay green on the final file. Each screen is read when it appears by a fact and again after its answer; the test moves on within tens of milliseconds, so a delayed text lands on a screen already left (or after the last read of the result). Seeing it needs time to pass on the page, which a spec may get only by a wait by time (forbidden: no sleep). A fact-based way exists outside this file: the page's own clock run forward by the debugging protocol (Emulation.setVirtualTimePolicy with a budget, which ends with an event), a feature of the kit (REQ-104) with its own requirement. Proposal: ORCH records it like О13 and S22 (not testable with the tools of this run), or opens it for the kit.

Places of B's page the test does not read (outside criterion 6 and О19 as written; no mutant of mine): text drawn by CSS generated content (::before, ::after) or into canvas, SVG images and pictures; text inside a shadow root (textContent and the tree walk do not enter it); the value property of a field; a second window that B's page opens; dialogs; and A's texts in kk and en (the set of criterion 6 is built from A's questionnaire in ru and B's pass runs in ru). Recorded by О19 as outside: the response headers and the number values of A.

Beyond the letter of О19, within its meaning, for ORCH to record (decisions/0109) and for DOC-UPDATER at step 10: the page read takes every attribute, not only the four named (aria-valuetext of the progress bar is said by a screen reader), and the address of the page; an exception word must stand only inside the measured text of B (pinned with that text); the request check is completed by two controls that the records hold the requests of the page (no service worker registration; a dedicated or shared worker shows as its script with no answer) and by a search of what the page and its shared files bring. Each is measured clean on the correct server (no exception) and each has a mutant red only by it (A15, A16, A19, A2d, A2f, A14, A18).

For step 10 (DOC-UPDATER, as decisions/0109 О19 says): design section 8, row 6 and section 4.4 (helpers) are behind the test: the reads of every screen of B's pass (text of the page, title, address, every attribute, whole texts, text nodes), the pinned holder of «человек», the requests with the shared path /assets/<name> and its reason, the two controls (answer of every record, no service worker), the search of the bodies of the page and its files, the keys and the 13 named fields with the error answer's 3; the mutants of this step (G01, G02, G05, G06, G08 now red; own A1-A19; the timing probes T1-T3 of I1) for section 16; the criterion 6 precision of О19. Two lessons of this step. (1) An exception that compares a word with whole texts only needs a pin of where the word stands (the text that holds it): otherwise the same word placed inside another text of the same screen passes (A2d, A2f survived the first launch's edit). (2) A check that reads the network records of a page sees only what the page itself asks: a worker or a service worker of the page asks unseen (A8, A14, A17, shown with a request log of the server in a copy); such a check needs a control that the records hold every request, and a named shared path needs a check that it brings nothing of the other tenant (A18).

All runs on one machine (macOS, 10 cores, 16 GB, Node 22.23.4, Chrome/157.0.8103.78); the GitHub runner is not measured here (decisions/0110: TEST-RUNNER). The new checks do not depend on timing on the correct code: every screen is waited for by a fact, the requests and bodies are read after B's result answer was read, and the service worker registrations are a fact of the origin.
